title: Claude Code plugin commands are prefixed with the plugin name
body: Expect every plugin skill to appear as /<plugin name>:<skill name>, where the plugin name is the "name" in .claude-plugin/plugin.json. DD's plugin is named dd, so its skills are /dd:save, /dd:recall and /dd:review, and the marketplace install id is dd@deltadictum. Renaming the plugin changes both the command prefix and the install id and makes existing users reinstall; the npm package name (deltadictum) is separate. Why: the prefix comes from the plugin manifest, not from the skill names, so naming the skills alone does not produce it; an earlier version of this memory predated the rename and said the plugin was named deltadictum.
not_derivable: The prefix comes from the plugin manifest's name, which no skill file shows; renaming the plugin changes the install id for every user.

evidence.summary: Install section: /plugin install dd@deltadictum; the command table lists /dd:* commands.
